item.title: azure: [In preview] Public Preview: Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision
item.description:
Azure Bastion RDP and SSH vision is in public preview. It adds AI-assisted review for recorded privileged sessions, including session summaries and insights into noteworthy or risky activity.

  • Source: Azure Updates

item.title: github: Security improvements for SSH
item.description:
GitHub is updating SSH security by removing several older algorithms, adding a new one, and requiring larger RSA SSH keys. The change tightens supported SSH configurations to improve security.

  • Source: GitHub
